# this is the build file for project 
# it is autogenerated by the xmake build system.
# do not edit by hand.

# project
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15.0)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0091 NEW)
project(class_practise LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID})
set(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT})
if(NOT CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT)
    if(MSVC)
        set(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT "MSVC")
    else()
        set(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT "GNU")
    endif()
endif()
if(DEFINED CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT)
    set(CURRENT_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT})
endif()
if(NOT CURRENT_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT)
    set(CURRENT_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT ${CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT})
endif()

# target
add_executable(class_practise "")
set_target_properties(class_practise PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "class_practise")
set_target_properties(class_practise PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux/arm64/release")
target_include_directories(class_practise PRIVATE
    include
)
target_include_directories(class_practise INTERFACE
    include
)
target_compile_options(class_practise PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-DNDEBUG>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-DNDEBUG>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-DNDEBUG>
)
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(class_practise PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-O2>)
else()
    target_compile_options(class_practise PRIVATE -O3)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
else()
    target_compile_options(class_practise PRIVATE -fvisibility=hidden)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    set_property(TARGET class_practise PROPERTY
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()
# private sourcefiles from sourcebatch c++.build for target class_practise
target_sources(class_practise PRIVATE 
    src/main.cpp
)
